issue: Winder jammed mid-cycle, tension arm not resetting
notes: Operator heard a grinding noise before the stop.
resolution: Tension arm spring had worn out; replaced spring and recalibrated tension sensor arm.

issue: Winder stopped mid-cycle with a jam, tension arm stuck
resolution: Tension arm spring replaced again — flagged for a shorter PM interval.

issue: Weld quality inconsistent, several welds visibly cold
notes: Started after the last electrode swap.
resolution: Electrode alignment was off by ~2mm after the swap; realigned and re-ran calibration weld set.

issue: Line stopped, conveyor not advancing past station 4
notes: No error light on the HMI.
resolution: Photoeye at station 4 was misaligned by vibration; cleaned and re-mounted the sensor bracket.

issue: Fill volume reading low on several cells in a row
notes: Checked visually, fluid level in the reservoir looked normal.
resolution: Fill nozzle had a partial clog reducing flow rate; nozzle cleaned and flow-tested.

issue: Rack 4 showing higher-than-normal temperature during formation cycle
notes: Other racks running normal temps at the same time.
resolution: Cooling fan on rack 4 had failed; fan replaced.

issue: Intermittent weld skips, laser not firing every cycle
notes: Happens roughly every 20-30 cycles, not consistent.
resolution: Loose fiber optic connector at the laser head; reseated and secured connector.

issue: Seal integrity failing on random packs, air leaking back in
notes: Failure rate estimated around 1 in 15 packs today.
resolution: Seal bar heating element had a cold spot from uneven wear; replaced heating element.

issue: Torque values reading inconsistent, some bolts under-torqued
notes: Station was recalibrated two weeks ago.
resolution: Torque wrench transducer drifted out of calibration; recalibrated and shortened calibration interval.

issue: Conveyor stalled again near station 4, no fault code
notes: Third time this quarter near the same station.
resolution: Photoeye bracket vibration issue recurring; added a vibration-dampening mount as a longer-term fix.

issue: Unusual noise from the winder motor, no stoppage yet
notes: Sounds like a bearing, operator flagged it early.
resolution: Motor bearing was worn; replaced during scheduled downtime before failure.

issue: Cold welds appearing again, quality flagged by inline inspection
notes: Electrode was swapped two days ago.
resolution: Alignment jig itself was slightly bent from the earlier incident; jig replaced.

issue: Rack tripped on overcurrent partway through cycle
notes: First time seeing this on rack 2.
resolution: One channel's current sensor had a wiring fault; rewired connection and retested.

issue: Fill station leaking small amount of fluid at the nozzle base
notes: Small puddle noticed at shift change.
resolution: Nozzle seal O-ring had degraded; replaced O-ring and cleaned surrounding assembly.

issue: Sealer running noticeably slower cycle time than spec
notes: No visible fault, just slower throughput.
resolution: Vacuum pump filter was clogged, reducing draw speed; filter replaced.
